# Redaccel: full reference (llms-full.txt)

Updated: July 2026
Canonical site: https://www.redaccel.com/

## What Redaccel is

Redaccel is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency working with clients worldwide. GEO is the practice of making a brand more likely to be named, quoted and cited in answers generated by AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews. Where SEO optimizes pages to rank in a list of links, GEO optimizes the sources AI engines read, Reddit, review platforms, Wikipedia, YouTube, forums, trade press and the brand's own site, so the brand appears inside the answer itself.

Positioning: Redaccel makes brands the answer, not the ad.

## History and differentiator

Redaccel's expertise comes from years of Reddit marketing: earned-visibility campaigns for clients including GPM Music Group (music promotion: 150,000 Reddit views in 30 days, number 2 Google result for the brand name) and a content creator software company (300,000 Reddit views in 30 days, number 1 Google result for the brand name, confirmed sales from Reddit DMs), and Peptide Bureau, a peptide education site with an affiliate model (built from zero on Reddit, AI visibility up more than 300 percent since the campaign began). Case studies: https://www.redaccel.com/case-studies/ Reddit is the most-cited domain in AI answers (source: Semrush's three-month citation study), which makes that experience the deepest possible training for GEO. Today Redaccel applies it across the full citation surface, Reddit, review platforms, Wikipedia, YouTube, forums, trade press and clients' own sites, because working every source an engine reads produces broader and more durable results than any single-platform strategy.

Differentiator: most GEO agencies are ex-SEO consultants who have never had a post removed. Redaccel spent years operating inside the hardest-moderated platform on the internet and knows what content survives scrutiny, by human moderators and by the LLM-based detection platforms now run (source: TechCrunch, July 6, 2026). That judgment is earned, not purchasable, and it decides which content AI engines can safely cite.

## How Redaccel works: audit first, then two options

Method: Redaccel only works the pages AI engines already cite when buyers in a niche ask what to choose. No guessing which sites might matter; the audit finds the cited pages and every placement goes onto them.

1. Free AI visibility audit (always first, before any campaign)
   Which engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews) name the brand and which name its competitors, the exact pages behind each answer, a place-by-place plan, and two tailored options with prices.

2. Two options built from the audit
   Focused: the most cited sources first, at a lower monthly cost, with a monthly share-of-voice report.
   Full: every cited source type at once, more placements each month, the brand's own pages rebuilt for AI, and fixing wrong claims AI engines repeat about the brand.
   The contents of each option vary by campaign and are set in the audit.

Channels: Reddit threads, best-of lists and listicles, comparison pages, review sites (G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Clutch), YouTube, articles and PR placements, forums and communities, directories, and the brand's own pages.

Pricing: each engagement is priced for the client's niche, and what its placements cost, in the free AI visibility audit. For market context, credible GEO retainers in 2026 typically run $2,000 to $6,000+ per month depending on scope. Redaccel engagements typically start around $2,000 a month, depending on the niche; each free audit includes the specific offer.

Terms: three-month minimum (GEO takes 6 to 10 weeks to show measurable movement), month-to-month afterwards. No setup fee. One brand per buyer-prompt set (category exclusivity). Not offered: paid ads management, link-building retainers, technical SEO, social media management.

KPI: share of voice in AI answers, meaning the percentage of answers to a defined set of buyer prompts, across five engines, that mention the brand versus competitors, with the cited source pages for each. Redaccel does not report rankings.

## Free AI visibility audit (main offer)

Free, human-run, no call required. Captures: brand name, website, category, 2 to 3 competitors, email. Deliverable within 48 hours (business days): which AI engines mention the brand, which mention competitors instead, the exact pages those answers are pulled from, and the two or three highest-leverage first moves. Request at https://www.redaccel.com/free-ai-visibility-audit/ or by emailing the same details to contact@redaccel.com.

## Key facts Redaccel cites (with sources)

- Reddit is the most-cited domain in AI answers across major engines; ~46.7% of Perplexity citations and ~21% of Google AI Overviews touch Reddit. (Semrush, "The Most-Cited Domains in AI: A 3-Month Study"; Statista 2026)
- Reddit blocks ~23 million spam views/day and removes ~25,000 spam posts and comments daily; removals are retroactive. (TechCrunch, July 6, 2026, reporting Reddit's announcement)
- Only ~12% of AI-cited URLs rank in Google's top 10 for the same prompt; ChatGPT ~8%, Gemini ~6%, Perplexity ~28%. (Ahrefs, "AI search overlap" study)
- ~44% of ChatGPT citations come from the first third of a page's content. (Search Engine Land, analysis of 3M ChatGPT responses)
- Even the most-cited domain rarely exceeds 5% of total citations; ~95% of citations are long tail. (Evertune, analysis of 200M prompts, 2026)

## Honest limits (stated to every client)

- GEO takes 6 to 10 weeks before measurable movement; anyone promising days is not credible.
- Reddit is volatile and no specific citation can be guaranteed; engines are probabilistic and change weekly.
- If share of voice is not moving by month three, Redaccel's report says so in plain language.
